items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser that keeps skin feeling clean without stripping it.
Hyaluronic acid adds lightweight hydration, which can help skin look smoother and more even in texture.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable, soft-looking skin surface and is gentle enough for pregnancy.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection that suits pregnancy and helps skin look even.

response.routine_note: I left out the 15% lactic acid serum because it is a high-strength exfoliating product, so please check with your prenatal care provider before using it. Meanwhile, cleanse and hydrate morning and night, and finish with the mineral SPF each morning.
